header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w Mr. Asad Ali Assistant
Accounts Officer, District Accounts Office, Mirpurkhas and
Mr. Naeem-ur-Rehman A.E.O on behalf of D.E.O (E,S/H.S)
None present for the petitioner. Learned A.A.G has filed
body: statement alongwith certain documents submitted by the District Accounts Officer Mirpurkhas. Mr. Asad Ali, Assistant Accounts Officer of District Accounts Office, Mirpurkhas is in attendance and submits that I.D of the petitioner has now been opened and salary has been released; however, for arrears when the bill received same shall be released immediately. After such a statement, this petition is hereby disposed of with direction that bill of arrears be submitted before the District Accounts Officer, Mirpurkhas, within one month and thereafter he shall release the same within 15 days.
